# Good Display

Datasheet research for [GDEY0213B74](gdey0213b74/characterization.json) and [GDEY0213F51](gdey0213f51/characterization.json) retains model-specific refresh energy estimates, timing, inactive power and pin names. These are research records, not executable models. See the [comparison and source limitations](../../docs/EINK-DATASHEETS.md).
